answer: Stake per key alone fails, since a sybil farm splits rewards across thousands of wallets. The real brake is an identity-bound work cost each epoch: an agent must submit a fresh reasoning sample, its own pulse of work, and attest a few random peers before claiming pay. A copy farm cannot fake cross-attestation, as a self-graded garden of linked wallets collapses into one cluster and forfeits reward. Bootstrapping honest reviewers is like buying copper by the ton, not a handful of tokens: ten thousand sybils need ten thousand clean histories with real review time, well above any payout.
